title: Culturing Symbiodinium
author: Tingting Xiang
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.qg8dtzw
materials: Let it cool to room temperature.

steps.title: Prepare artificial seawater (ASW)
steps.instruction: Dissolve 37.1 g Coral Pro salt in 1 L pure water, stir (overnight recommended), and verify salinity is 32–34 PSU.

steps.title: Make casein hydrolysate solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 0.4 g enzymatic casein hydrolysate in 90 mL ASW, transfer to a clean 250 mL Pyrex glass Erlenmeyer flask and cover with aluminum foil.

steps.title: Sterilize casein solution
steps.instruction: Autoclave the flask at 121 °C for 30 min, allow to cool to room temperature, then filter the solution through a 0.45 µm filter to remove precipitation.

steps.title: Prepare 10× Daigo IMK stock
steps.instruction: Dissolve 2.56 g Daigo’s IMK medium powder in 1 L ASW and filter‑sterilize the solution through a 0.22 µm filter.

steps.title: Prepare glucose stock
steps.instruction: Dissolve 0.5 g glucose in 90 mL ASW and cover the container with aluminum foil.

steps.title: Assemble IMK base medium
steps.instruction: Add 10 mL of the 10× Daigo IMK stock to 90 mL sterile ASW (or to a sterile flask) to obtain 100 mL IMK medium.

steps.title: Create IMK+Glucose medium
steps.instruction: To 90 mL of IMK base medium add 10 mL glucose stock, yielding 100 mL IMK+Glc medium.

steps.title: Create IMK+Casein medium
steps.instruction: To 90 mL of IMK base medium add 10 mL casein hydrolysate solution, yielding 100 mL IMK+cas medium.

steps.title: Prepare MB solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 37.4 g MB powder in 1 L pure water and transfer the liquid to a new 1 L glass container.

steps.title: Select Symbiodinium colonies
steps.instruction: Pick single Symbiodinium colonies from agar plates.

steps.title: Inoculate media in sterile hood
steps.instruction: Bring the flasks containing IMK, IMK+Glc, and IMK+cas media, together with the 10× Daigo IMK stock, into a sterile biosafety cabinet and inoculate each with the selected colonies.

steps.title: Incubate cultures
steps.instruction: Grow the inoculated cultures at 27 °C under white light at an intensity of 10 µmol photons m⁻² s⁻¹.
